prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1163; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision described in your insured's claim file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office, and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone or in writing. Our client has sustained injuries that require ongoing medical treatment, and we are gathering the documentation needed to present a full evaluation of the claim.

To allow us to assess the claim properly, we request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page. We also ask that you confirm whether any other policies may apply.

Please ensure that all evidence relating to this collision is preserved. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, witness statements, recorded calls, adjuster notes, and any repair estimates or total loss valuations. Destruction or alteration of such material could prejudice our client's rights, and we expect your cooperation in maintaining it.
